findings.title: DemoOrder.createdAt is final, cannot be reassigned on transfer
findings.description: The design shows updating order.createdAt on transfer, but the actual source code declares it as 'final DateTime createdAt' which cannot be reassigned in Dart.
findings.fix: Change DemoOrder.createdAt from 'final' to mutable, then update _transferOrderDirect() to reset the timestamp

findings.title: Settings persistence methods lack complete specification
findings.description: The design adds saveSettings() and loadSettings() but doesn't specify return type, error handling for network failures vs. first run, or the exact method signature.
findings.fix: Provide complete method signatures with explicit error handling for network failures and first-run scenarios

findings.title: Batch settlement duplicate prevention check placement unclear
findings.description: The duplicate check settledBatchIds.contains() occurs after finding the batch to settle, creating ambiguity about race condition prevention. The design acknowledges Edge Case 8 but doesn't clarify execution order.
findings.fix: Clarify that the duplicate check must occur immediately after identifying batchToSettle and before any settlement operations

findings.title: Batch period enforcement logic integration unclear
findings.description: The design introduces checkBatchCompletion() but doesn't clearly state whether it replaces checkAndAutoSettleBatch() or is called by it.
findings.fix: Specify that checkAndAutoSettleBatch() should be completely replaced with the new logic, or show how checkBatchCompletion() integrates with existing method

findings.title: Write-through pattern async usage ambiguous in UI handlers
findings.description: The design shows setState inside try block after await, but doesn't clearly show the async function wrapper and proper error handling flow.
findings.fix: Provide complete async function signatures showing await before setState, with clear separation of success and error paths

findings.title: Batch division field serialization format unspecified
findings.description: The design states division is saved as 'array' but doesn't specify Firestore Array vs string vs other format, affecting deserialization in loadBatches().
findings.fix: Specify that division is saved as Firestore List<int> and show the exact deserialization code with List.from() cast

findings.title: Batch restoration from Firestore implementation missing
findings.description: The design describes batch restoration in Edge Case 2 but doesn't show WHERE or HOW batches are restored in oms_demo.dart. No new method is specified.
findings.fix: Add restoreBatchesFromFirestore() method to DemoOmsStore and show its invocation from main()

findings.title: Wallet update persistence not implemented in settlement
findings.description: The rewritten settleCurrentBatch() updates in-memory wallet but has only a comment about Firestore update, no actual call to updateResellerWallet().
findings.fix: Add await FirestoreService.updateResellerWallet() call in the settlement loop after each wallet update

findings.title: Settings validation enforcement location unclear
findings.description: The design specifies validation rules but doesn't show where validation is enforced - UI layer or service layer.
findings.fix: Either add validation to saveSettings() or document that validation occurs in UI before calling the method

findings.title: Audit log timestamp format inconsistent with implementation
findings.description: The design states log format includes [timestamp] prefix, but code examples show logs without timestamps.
findings.fix: Either add timestamp prefix to all log entries or update the format specification to remove [timestamp] prefix

summary.reason: 3 HIGH findings and 5 MEDIUM findings must be resolved before implementation. Core issues: final field reassignment, missing method specifications, and incomplete async patterns.
